dialogue.context: Ramero；本轮实测对白。
dialogue.raw: §7** shivers **
dialogue.text: ** shivers **
dialogue.zh: **瑟瑟发抖**

dialogue.context: Ramero / During Detective Amog 's first reverse-murder quest
dialogue.raw: §fOh misery, is this my end?
dialogue.text: Oh misery, is this my end?
dialogue.zh: 唉，命运何其残酷，难道我就要命丧于此?

dialogue.context: Ramero / During Detective Amog 's first reverse-murder quest
dialogue.raw: §fIs mine own §4death §ftruly inevitable?
dialogue.text: Is mine own death truly inevitable?
dialogue.zh: 难道我真的逃不过死亡?

dialogue.context: Ramero / Selecting [ I'm afraid so, but we found you right on time. ] (Activates Once)
dialogue.raw: §fI beseech thee, I am an honest man. Please do not take my life.
dialogue.text: I beseech thee, I am an honest man. Please do not take my life.
dialogue.zh: 求求你，我是个本分的人，请别取我的性命。

dialogue.context: Ramero / Selecting [ I'm afraid so, but we found you right on time. ] (Activates Once)
dialogue.raw: §fFor I am to wed fair §eJoliet§f, and begin a family.
dialogue.text: For I am to wed fair Joliet, and begin a family.
dialogue.zh: 我还要迎娶美丽的Joliet，与她建立一个家。

segments.text: For I am to wed fair

dialogue.context: Ramero / Hitting Ramero with Tactician's Murder Weapon
dialogue.raw: §fOw! That doth smart!
dialogue.text: Ow! That doth smart!
dialogue.zh: 啊! 好痛!

dialogue.context: Ramero /
dialogue.raw: §fFie! That pain doth gnaw at my very soul!
dialogue.text: Fie! That pain doth gnaw at my very soul!
dialogue.zh: 唉! 这痛楚仿佛在啃噬我的灵魂!

dialogue.context: Ramero /
dialogue.raw: §fZounds! That doth truly hurt!
dialogue.text: Zounds! That doth truly hurt!
dialogue.zh: 天啊! 真是痛彻心扉!

dialogue.context: Ramero /
dialogue.raw: §fBy heaven! That wound doth ache!
dialogue.text: By heaven! That wound doth ache!
dialogue.zh: 苍天在上! 这伤口痛得厉害!

dialogue.context: Ramero /
dialogue.raw: §fPrithee, the pain is almost unbearable!
dialogue.text: Prithee, the pain is almost unbearable!
dialogue.zh: 求求你，这痛苦几乎让我无法承受!

dialogue.context: Ramero / Upon being killed
dialogue.raw: §fI beg of you... convey to §eJoliet §fthat my §dlove §ffor her shall never die...
dialogue.text: I beg of you... convey to Joliet that my love for her shall never die...
dialogue.zh: 求你……转告Joliet，我对她的爱永不消逝……

segments.text: I beg of you... convey to

dialogue.context: Ramero / Upon being killed
dialogue.raw: §fNot even in §cdeath§f.
dialogue.text: Not even in death.
dialogue.zh: 纵使死亡也无法改变。

dialogue.context: Ramero /  Taylor's | During Detective Amog 's second reverse-murder quest
dialogue.raw: §fUpon my home's floor, grim bloodstains I found.
dialogue.text: Upon my home's floor, grim bloodstains I found.
dialogue.zh: 我在自家地板上发现了骇人的血迹。

dialogue.context: Ramero /  Taylor's | During Detective Amog 's second reverse-murder quest
dialogue.raw: §fAn awful sign that death's shadow grows near.
dialogue.text: An awful sign that death's shadow grows near.
dialogue.zh: 这是凶兆，预示着死神的阴影正步步逼近。

dialogue.context: Ramero /  Taylor's | During Detective Amog 's second reverse-murder quest
dialogue.raw: §fOvertaken by dread, I thought to flee, yet how to save myself I know not.
dialogue.text: Overtaken by dread, I thought to flee, yet how to save myself I know not.
dialogue.zh: 恐惧将我淹没，我想逃离，却不知该如何自救。

dialogue.context: Ramero /  Taylor's | During Detective Amog 's second reverse-murder quest
dialogue.raw: §fI am compelled to live, for should I fall, §eJoliet §fwould wander this world alone until death's embrace reunites us.
dialogue.text: I am compelled to live, for should I fall, Joliet would wander this world alone until death's embrace reunites us.
dialogue.zh: 我必须活下去。若我倒下，Joliet 便只能独自行走世间，直到死亡让我们重逢。

segments.text: I am compelled to live, for should I fall,
segments.zh: 我必须活下去。若我倒下，

segments.text: would wander this world alone until death's embrace reunites us.
segments.zh: 便只能独自行走世间，直到死亡让我们重逢。

dialogue.context: Ramero / Selecting [ I don't think this place is safe for you then. ]
dialogue.raw: §fI must then take flight.
dialogue.text: I must then take flight.
dialogue.zh: 那我必须尽快逃离。

dialogue.context: Ramero / Selecting [ I don't think this place is safe for you then. ]
dialogue.raw: §fI resolve to §cbarricade §fmy abode with materials at hand.
dialogue.text: I resolve to barricade my abode with materials at hand.
dialogue.zh: 我决定用手边的材料封住自己的居所。

segments.text: my abode with materials at hand.

dialogue.context: Ramero / Selecting [ I don't think this place is safe for you then. ]
dialogue.raw: §fYet, without aid, I fear my preparations will fall short of time's cruel demand.
dialogue.text: Yet, without aid, I fear my preparations will fall short of time's cruel demand.
dialogue.zh: 可若是无人相助，只怕残酷的时间不会等我准备妥当。

dialogue.context: Ramero / Selecting [ I will help you, let's get to your house. ]
dialogue.raw: §fThanks unto thee, %s!
dialogue.text: Thanks unto thee, %s!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你，%s!

dialogue.context: Ramero / Selecting [ I will help you, let's get to your house. ]
dialogue.raw: §fMay our united efforts grant me victory against the dire fate that shadows my path.
dialogue.text: May our united efforts grant me victory against the dire fate that shadows my path.
dialogue.zh: 愿你我齐心协力，助我战胜如影随形的厄运。

dialogue.context: Ramero / Before going back to the  Murder House
dialogue.raw: §fLet us assemble at mine own house.
dialogue.text: Let us assemble at mine own house.
dialogue.zh: 我们在我家会合吧。

dialogue.context: Ramero /  Murder House | Before barricading the wall
dialogue.raw: §fI have collected yon materials upon the floor.
dialogue.text: I have collected yon materials upon the floor.
dialogue.zh: 那些地上的材料，是我收集来的。

dialogue.context: Ramero /  Murder House | Before barricading the wall
dialogue.raw: §fLet us employ these §cplanks §fto fortify the §centrance§f.
dialogue.text: Let us employ these planks to fortify the entrance.
dialogue.zh: 我们用这些木板封住入口吧。

dialogue.context: Ramero /  Murder House | Before barricading the wall
dialogue.raw: §fMake haste, for the villain may arrive forthwith.
dialogue.text: Make haste, for the villain may arrive forthwith.
dialogue.zh: 动作快些，恶徒随时可能到来。

dialogue.context: Ramero / After barricading the wall
dialogue.raw: §fSee how this barricade holds firm; it is a fortress in its own right.
dialogue.text: See how this barricade holds firm; it is a fortress in its own right.
dialogue.zh: 看，这屏障多么坚固，简直就是一座堡垒。

dialogue.context: Ramero / After barricading the wall
dialogue.raw: §fTruly, they instill a newfound sense of safety.
dialogue.text: Truly, they instill a newfound sense of safety.
dialogue.zh: 看着它们，我心中终于又有了几分安宁。

dialogue.context: Ramero / After barricading the wall
dialogue.raw: §fMy gratitude for thy aid is boundless, for thy labors were crucial, and alone I stood no chance.
dialogue.text: My gratitude for thy aid is boundless, for thy labors were crucial, and alone I stood no chance.
dialogue.zh: 你的帮助，我感激不尽。若没有你付出这番辛劳，单靠我一人绝无胜算。

dialogue.context: Ramero / After being saved from death
dialogue.raw: §fThou hast delivered me from death's cold grasp, when all seemed lost to cruel fate's design.
dialogue.text: Thou hast delivered me from death's cold grasp, when all seemed lost to cruel fate's design.
dialogue.zh: 就在我以为残酷的命运已成定局时，是你将我从死亡的冰冷掌心救了出来。

dialogue.context: Ramero / After being saved from death
dialogue.raw: §fMy heart, once frail, now beats anew, by thy noble hand restored.
dialogue.text: My heart, once frail, now beats anew, by thy noble hand restored.
dialogue.zh: 我曾经脆弱的心，因你的义举重获生机，再次有力地跳动。

dialogue.context: Ramero / After being saved from death
dialogue.raw: §fThis ring, once forged in love's sweet name, now lies as broken as the vow it bore.
dialogue.text: This ring, once forged in love's sweet name, now lies as broken as the vow it bore.
dialogue.zh: 这枚戒指曾因甜蜜的爱意铸成，如今却和它承载的誓言一样，支离破碎。

dialogue.context: Ramero / After being saved from death
dialogue.raw: §fYet methinks it holds a greater meaning still - one of survival, of hope reborn.
dialogue.text: Yet methinks it holds a greater meaning still - one of survival, of hope reborn.
dialogue.zh: 可我想，它仍有更深的意义——劫后余生，希望重燃。

dialogue.context: Ramero / After being saved from death
dialogue.raw: §fI can no longer bear its weight, for it is both wound and memory. But thou, dear savior, shouldst take it.
dialogue.text: I can no longer bear its weight, for it is both wound and memory. But thou, dear savior, shouldst take it.
dialogue.zh: 它既是伤痕，也是回忆，我已无法再承受这份重量。亲爱的恩人，请你收下。

dialogue.context: Ramero / After being saved from death
dialogue.raw: §fNot as token of despair, but as a sign that even the broken may yet be saved, as I have been by thee.
dialogue.text: Not as token of despair, but as a sign that even the broken may yet be saved, as I have been by thee.
dialogue.zh: 它不是绝望的信物，而是一个证明: 纵使破碎，也仍有获救的希望，就像你拯救了我一样。
